meta.policy: 人工翻译语料；仅按术语表做少量人名/卡名覆盖。空值、非字符串、原文照抄不写入。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is discarded by an effect of an attack used by the Pokémon this card is attached to, attach this card from your discard pile to that Pokémon after attacking.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡因附着此卡的宝可梦所使用招式的效果而被弃置，则在攻击后从弃牌堆将此卡附着于该宝可梦。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Stage 2 Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于 2 阶进化宝可梦，则此卡提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 2 个能量。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此卡附着的宝可梦造成的所有效果。（已有的效果不会被移除。伤害不是效果。）

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. This effect of your Legacy Energy only works once per game.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 1 个能量。

若此卡附着的宝可梦因对手的宝可梦所用招式的伤害而被击倒，则该玩家少拿 1 张奖赏卡。你的「遗产能量」的这个效果每局只能生效 1 次。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, draw 4 cards.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

当你从手牌将此卡附着于宝可梦时，抽 4 张牌。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手的宝可梦所用招式的伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则在攻击的宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

items.en:
This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket’s Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket’s Pokémon, discard this card.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of {P} Energy and {D} Energy.
items.zh:
此卡只能附着于火箭队的宝可梦。若此卡附着于火箭队的宝可梦以外的对象，则弃置此卡。

只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 2 个能量，其属性为 {P} 能量与 {D} 能量的任意组合。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于基础宝可梦，则此卡提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 1 个能量。

items.en:
If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon, it provides {C}{C}{C} Energy instead.
items.zh:
若此卡附着于你的 1 只宝可梦，则在你回合结束时弃置此卡。

只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于进化宝可梦，则改为提供 {C}{C}{C} 能量。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {G} Energy.
The {G} Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {G} 能量。
此卡附着的 {G} 宝可梦的 HP +20。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {P} Energy.
When you attach this card from your hand to a {P} Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {P} 能量。
当你从手牌将此卡附着于 {P} 宝可梦时，从牌库中检索至多 2 只基础 {P} 宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

items.en:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {F} Energy.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to the {F} Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
items.zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {F} 能量。
防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此卡附着的 {F} 宝可梦造成的所有效果。（已有的效果不会被移除。伤害不是效果。）

items.en: Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of your Benched Pokémon and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索数量不超过你后备宝可梦数量的卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
items.zh: 将对手的战斗宝可梦换入后备。（由对手选择新的战斗宝可梦。）

items.en: This attack also does 40 damage to each Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it (both yours and your opponent’s). (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 此招式还对身上放有伤害指示物的每只后备宝可梦（你的与对手的）造成 40 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

items.en: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
items.zh: 抛 4 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 30 点伤害。
items.ctx: card=Team Rocket's Kangaskhan ex attack=Comet Punch

items.en: If you played a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.
items.zh: 若你在本回合从手牌使用了名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡，则此招式的伤害 +100。
items.ctx: card=Team Rocket's Kangaskhan ex attack=Wicked Impact

items.en: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. At the end of your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.
items.zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。在对手的下个回合结束时，战斗宝可梦将被击倒。

items.en: Attach a Basic {G} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal all damage from that Pokémon.
items.zh: 从手牌中把 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡附着于你的 1 只后备宝可梦。若如此做，回复该宝可梦的所有伤害。

items.en: Put up to 2 Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 从弃牌堆中取至多 2 只宝可梦加入手牌。

items.en: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent’s last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.
items.zh: 若你的任意宝可梦在对手的上个回合中因招式的伤害而被击倒，则此招式的伤害 +60。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，就防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害与效果。

items.en: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each Basic {G} Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those Energy cards into your deck.
items.zh: 你的弃牌堆中每有 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡，就在对手的 1 只宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。然后将那些能量卡洗回牌库。

items.en: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的每只宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

items.en: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.
items.zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入灼伤。

items.en: Discard the top card of each player’s deck. This attack does 140 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.
items.zh: 弃置每位玩家牌库顶的 1 张卡。以此方式弃置的每张能量卡使此招式的伤害 +140。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，就防止招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害（你的与对手的）。

items.en: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 60 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.
items.zh: 若场上有竞技场卡，则此招式的伤害 +60。然后弃置那个竞技场。

items.en: At the end of your opponent’s next turn, put 9 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合结束时，在战斗宝可梦上放置 9 个伤害指示物。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Froakie and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索至多 2 只呱呱泡蛙并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦陷入麻痹。
回复此宝可梦的 20 点伤害。

items.en: Put up to 9 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.
items.zh: 在此宝可梦上放置至多 9 个伤害指示物。以此方式放置的每个伤害指示物使此招式造成 20 点伤害。

items.en: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.
items.zh: 从弃牌堆中把至多 2 张基本能量卡以你喜欢的方式附着于你的宝可梦。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。查看你牌库顶的 1 张卡。你可以弃置那张卡。

items.en: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 将此宝可梦身上的 1 个能量移动到你的 1 只后备宝可梦上。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Pokémon with a Rule Box in play (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Abilities, except for Future Pokémon. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，场上拥有规则栏的宝可梦（你的与对手的）就没有特性，未来宝可梦除外。（宝可梦 ex、宝可梦 V 等拥有规则栏。）

items.en: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 此招式还对你的 1 只后备宝可梦造成 10 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

items.en: If any of your Pokémon in play are the same type as any of your opponent’s Pokémon in play, this attack does 120 more damage.
items.zh: 若你场上的任意宝可梦与对手场上的任意宝可梦属性相同，则此招式的伤害 +120。

items.en: You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 你可以从牌库中检索 1 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的 2 个能量。此招式对对手的 2 只宝可梦造成 120 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

items.en: If a Stadium is in play, this attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon, and discard that Stadium. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 若场上有竞技场卡，则此招式还对对手的每只后备宝可梦造成 30 点伤害，并弃置那个竞技场。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

items.en: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张从此宝可梦进化的卡并放置于此宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式的伤害 +20。

items.en: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
items.zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

items.en: Blood Moon used by this Pokémon costs {C} less for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
items.zh: 对手每已拿取 1 张奖赏卡，此宝可梦使用的「血月」所需能量就少 {C}。

items.en: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon {ex} or Benched Pokémon {V}. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 此招式对对手的 1 只后备宝可梦 ex 或后备宝可梦 V 造成 60 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

items.en: This Pokémon can’t use Blaze Blitz again until it leaves the Active Spot.
items.zh: 在此宝可梦离开战斗区之前，它无法再次使用「烈焰突袭」。

items.en: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦无法撤退。

items.en: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 将此宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

items.en: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Giant Wave.
items.zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「巨浪」。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may put 5 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, during this turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。在此宝可梦上放置 5 个伤害指示物。若如此做，则在本回合中，此宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +120（计算弱点和抗性之前）。

items.en: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张物品卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
items.zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 20 点伤害。

items.en: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself for each damage counter on it.
items.zh: 此宝可梦身上的每个伤害指示物使此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

items.en: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
items.zh: 抛 2 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 90 点伤害。

items.en: Discard up to 3 Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each Energy card you discarded in this way. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 从手牌中弃置至多 3 张能量卡。以此方式弃置的每张能量卡使此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 60 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

items.en: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
items.zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 10 点伤害。

items.en: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a {P} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.
items.zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是 {P} 宝可梦，则此招式的伤害 +30。

items.en: During your opponent’s next turn, they can’t play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon.
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合中，对手不能从手牌使用任何宝可梦来进化其宝可梦。

items.en: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent’s Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
items.zh: 以你喜欢的方式在对手的后备宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent’s Active Pokémon has no Abilities, except for Midnight Fluttering.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，对手的战斗宝可梦就没有特性，「午夜飘舞」除外。

items.en: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
items.zh: 你的每只进化宝可梦都可以使用其先前进化形态的任意招式。（你仍然需要必要的能量来使用每个招式。）

items.en: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck. If you played an Ancient Supporter card from your hand during this turn, discard 3 more cards in this way.
items.zh: 弃置对手牌库顶的 1 张卡。若你在本回合从手牌使用了古代支援者卡，则再以此方式弃置 3 张卡。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，弃置对手的战斗宝可梦身上的 1 个能量。

items.en: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
items.zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦陷入中毒。

items.en: This attack does 10 more damage for each Ancient card in your discard pile.
items.zh: 你的弃牌堆中每有 1 张古代卡，此招式的伤害 +10。

items.en: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Ancient Pokémon in play.
items.zh: 你场上每有 1 只古代宝可梦，此招式造成 30 点伤害。

items.en: This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 此招式的伤害不受对手的战斗宝可梦身上任何效果的影响。

items.en: Discard your hand and draw 6 cards.
items.zh: 弃置你的手牌，然后抽 6 张牌。

items.en: You may discard any amount of Basic Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
items.zh: 你可以弃置你的宝可梦身上任意数量的基本能量。以此方式弃置的每张卡使此招式造成 70 点伤害。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，则在对手的下个回合中，防止对此宝可梦造成的所有招式伤害与效果。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。抽 3 张牌。若你以此方式抽了牌，则将这只宝可梦及所有附着卡洗回你的牌库。

items.en: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦受到的招式伤害 -30（计算弱点和抗性之后）。

items.en: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
items.zh: 抛 3 次硬币。此招式每出现 1 次正面就造成 30 点伤害。

items.en: Choose 3 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. If you do, shuffle all of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon that you didn’t choose, and all cards attached to those Pokémon, into their deck.
items.zh: 选择对手的 3 只后备宝可梦。若如此做，将对手所有未被你选择的后备宝可梦及其附着卡洗回其牌库。

items.en: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
items.zh: 将此宝可梦身上附着的 1 个能量加入手牌。

items.en: Discard a {G} Energy from this Pokémon.
items.zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的 1 个 {G} 能量。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次。从牌库中检索 1 张竞技场卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
items.zh: 此宝可梦还对自己造成 10 点伤害。

items.en: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式的伤害 +30。

items.en: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon done to your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对你的后备宝可梦造成的所有伤害与效果。

items.en: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置于后备时，你可以将此宝可梦与你的战斗宝可梦互换。若如此做，你可以将你的其他宝可梦身上任意数量的能量移动到这只宝可梦身上。

items.en: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Burned, this attack does 40 more damage.
items.zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦处于灼伤状态，则此招式的伤害 +40。

items.en: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Flare Strike.
items.zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「烈焰打击」。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose Burned, Confused, or Poisoned. Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，抛硬币。若为正面，选择灼伤、混乱或中毒。对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于该特殊状态。

items.en: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 在造成伤害之前，弃置对手战斗宝可梦身上的所有宝可梦道具和特殊能量。

items.en: This attack does 30 more damage for each {G} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
items.zh: 自己所有宝可梦身上每附着 1 个 {G} 能量，此招式就造成 +30 伤害。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {G} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从手牌中把 1 张基本 {G} 能量卡附着于自己的 1 只宝可梦。若以此方式将能量附着于宝可梦，则回复那只宝可梦的 30 点伤害。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，此招式造成 +10 伤害。

items.en: This attack does 180 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 180 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

items.en: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
items.zh: 此宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式就造成 40 点伤害。

items.en: Look at the top 20 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看自己牌库上方的 20 张卡，从中以任意方式把任意数量的能量卡附着于自己的宝可梦。将其余的卡洗回牌库。

items.en: Attacks used by your Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Evolution Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗的进化宝可梦造成 +30 伤害（在应用弱点和抗性之前）。

items.en: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Haymaker.
items.zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用猛击。

items.en: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost {C} less for each Kofu card in your discard pile.
items.zh: 自己弃牌堆中每有 1 张卡芙卡，此宝可梦使用的招式费用就减少 {C}。

items.en: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.
items.zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦身上已有伤害指示物，则此招式造成 +80 伤害。

items.en: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon if that damage is 200 or more.
items.zh: 若伤害为 200 或更多，则防止对手宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {G} Energy cards and up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {G} 能量卡和最多 2 张基本 {L} 能量卡，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦。然后洗牌。

items.en: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a Pokémon {ex} or Pokémon {V}, this attack does 110 more damage.
items.zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是宝可梦 ex 或宝可梦 {V}，则此招式造成 +110 伤害。

items.en: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent’s next turn, they can’t play any Item cards from their hand.
items.zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。在对手的下个回合中，对手无法从手牌中打出任何物品卡。

items.en: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 从弃牌堆中把 1 只宝可梦加入手牌。

items.en: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is a Pokémon that doesn’t have a Rule Box, choose 1 of its attacks and use it as this attack. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
items.zh: 弃置自己牌库上方的 1 张卡，若该卡是不具有规则栏的宝可梦，则选择其 1 个招式并作为此招式使用。（宝可梦 ex、宝可梦 {V} 等具有规则栏。）

items.en: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
items.zh: 弃置此宝可梦身上的所有能量。

items.en: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your hand and your opponent has any Stage 2 Pokémon in play, you may put this Pokémon onto your Bench.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，若此宝可梦在你的手牌中且对手场上有 2 阶进化宝可梦，则你可以使用 1 次，将此宝可梦放置到后备。

items.en: Search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张宝可梦道具卡，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
items.zh: 此宝可梦每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式就造成 +10 伤害。

items.en: All of your Pokémon that have {M} Energy attached have no Retreat Cost.
items.zh: 自己所有附着了 {M} 能量的宝可梦没有撤退费用。

items.en: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 此宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式就对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 30 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

items.en: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
items.zh: 抛 3 次硬币。每次出现正面，此招式就造成 10 点伤害。

items.en: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, if you have any Tera Pokémon in play, you may search your deck for up to 2 Trainer cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌打出此宝可梦以进化自己的 1 只宝可梦时，若你场上有太晶宝可梦，则你可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索最多 2 张训练家卡，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: If there is no Stadium in play, this attack does nothing.
items.zh: 若场上没有竞技场，则此招式无效。

items.en: Once during your first turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 {C} Pokémon with 100 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can’t use more than 1 Fan Call Ability during your turn.
items.zh: 在你的首个回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索最多 3 只 HP 为 100 或以下的 {C} 宝可梦，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。你的回合中只能使用 1 次风扇呼唤特性。

items.en: As long as you have at least 1 other Bouffalant in play, all of your Basic {C} Pokémon take 60 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Curly Wall doesn’t stack.
items.zh: 只要场上还有至少 1 只其他的爆爆头水牛，自己所有基本 {C} 宝可梦受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害减少 60 点（在应用弱点和抗性之后）。卷毛之墙的效果不会叠加。

items.en: If you go second, you can’t use this attack during your first turn. This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 若你是后攻，则你无法在自己的首个回合中使用此招式。自己的后备宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式就造成 30 点伤害。

items.en: During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic non-{C} Pokémon.
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合中，防止非 {C} 的基础宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

items.en: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 若你是先攻，则你可以在自己的首个回合中使用此招式。从牌库中检索 1 张可从此宝可梦进化的卡，放置于此宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。

items.en: You may put all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand to have this attack do 80 more damage.
items.zh: 你可以将此宝可梦身上的所有能量放入手牌，使此招式的伤害 +80。

items.en: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a {N} Pokémon, it is now Paralyzed.
items.zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是 {N} 宝可梦，则其现在处于麻痹状态。

items.en: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
items.zh: 此宝可梦也会受到 30 点伤害。

items.en: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
items.zh: 若此宝可梦位于战斗区且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则在使用招式的宝可梦上放置 3 个伤害指示物。

items.en: You must put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
items.zh: 为了使用此特性，你必须将手牌中的 1 张卡置于牌库下方。在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，抽牌直到手牌有 5 张。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本 {P} 能量卡并附着于自己的 1 只后备宝可梦。然后洗牌。

items.en: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.
items.zh: 自己场上的基础宝可梦没有撤退费用。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦并放置到后备。然后洗牌。

items.en: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 50 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 在你的下个回合中，战斗宝可梦受到招式的伤害 +50（在应用弱点和抗性之后）。

items.en: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 你可以将此宝可梦与自己的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。

items.en: This attack does 100 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon {ex} and Pokémon {V}. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance.
items.zh: 此招式对对手的每 1 只宝可梦 ex 和宝可梦 {V} 造成 100 点伤害。此招式的伤害不受弱点或抗性影响。

items.en: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness.
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合中，此宝可梦没有弱点。

items.en: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {M} Energy cards from your discard pile to your {M} Pokémon in any way you like.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌打出此宝可梦以进化自己的 1 只宝可梦时，你可以从弃牌堆中以任意方式把最多 2 张基本 {M} 能量卡附着于自己的 {M} 宝可梦。

items.en: If this Pokémon evolved from Gimmighoul during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
items.zh: 若此宝可梦在本回合从索财灵进化而来，则此招式造成 +90 伤害。

items.en: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
items.zh: 你可以将此宝可梦及其身上的所有卡洗回牌库。

items.en: If your opponent has 3 or more Benched Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.
items.zh: 若对手有 3 只或更多的后备宝可梦，则此招式造成 +80 伤害。

items.en: You may attach any number of Basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.
items.zh: 你可以从手牌中以任意方式把任意数量的基本能量卡附着于自己的宝可梦。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, Knock Out your opponent’s Active Basic Pokémon. If tails, Knock Out 1 of your opponent’s Benched Basic Pokémon.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，击倒对手的战斗基础宝可梦。若为反面，击倒对手的 1 只后备基础宝可梦。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张基本能量卡，以任意方式附着于自己的宝可梦。然后洗牌。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，在对手的下个回合中，防止招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

items.en: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 2 张卡，洗牌，然后以任意顺序将这些卡置于牌库上方。

items.en: Discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex}.
items.zh: 从对手的战斗宝可梦 ex 上弃置 1 个能量。

items.en: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
items.zh: 对手每获得 1 张奖赏卡，此招式就造成 +30 伤害。

items.en: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置到后备时，你可以弃置对手牌库上方的 1 张卡。

items.en: If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack also does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 若自己牌库中的卡为 3 张或更少，则此招式还对对手的 2 只后备宝可梦造成 120 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

items.en: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
items.zh: 弃置自己牌库上方的 3 张卡。

items.en: Attacks used by your Evolution {R} Pokémon do 10 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 自己的进化 {R} 宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成 +10 伤害（在应用弱点和抗性之前）。

items.en: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s).
items.zh: 自己与对手的后备宝可梦每有 1 只，此招式就造成 +20 伤害。

items.en: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)
items.zh: 防止对手宝可梦使用的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有效果。（伤害不是效果。）

items.en: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
items.zh: 从此宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

items.en: This attack does 70 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
items.zh: 此宝可梦每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式就造成 +70 伤害。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is {G} and {R} type.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦在场上，它就是 {G} 属性和 {R} 属性。

items.en: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
items.zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

items.en: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent’s Tera Pokémon done to this Pokémon.
items.zh: 防止对手太晶宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害和效果。

items.en: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦放置到后备时，你可以弃置场上 1 张竞技场。
从此宝可梦身上弃置 3 个能量。

items.en: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.
items.zh: 若此宝可梦的 HP 为满且将被招式的伤害击倒，则它不会被击倒，其剩余 HP 变为 10。

items.en: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 3 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your {L} Pokémon in any way you like. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，从弃牌堆中以任意方式把最多 3 张基本能量卡附着于自己的 {L} 宝可梦。若你使用此特性，则此宝可梦被击倒。

items.en: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard all Item cards and Pokémon Tool cards you find there.
items.zh: 对手展示其手牌。弃置其中找到的所有物品卡和宝可梦道具卡。

items.en: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦身上每附着 1 个能量，此招式就造成 20 点伤害。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只 {L} 宝可梦，展示后加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.
items.zh: 若你剩余的奖赏卡比对手多，则此招式造成 +90 伤害。

items.en: When your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn’t stack.
items.zh: 当对手的战斗宝可梦被击倒时，抛硬币。若为正面，则多获得 1 张奖赏卡。奇迹之吻的效果不会叠加。

items.en: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 在对手的每只宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

items.en: Attach up to 2 Basic {P} Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.
items.zh: 从手牌中以任意方式把最多 2 张基本 {P} 能量卡附着于自己的宝可梦。

items.en: If you don’t have Uxie and Azelf on your Bench, this attack does nothing.
items.zh: 若你的后备没有由克希和亚克诺姆，则此招式无效。

items.en: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 对手所有宝可梦身上每有 1 个伤害指示物，此招式就造成 +10 伤害。

items.en: Put 6 damage counters on each Pokémon that has an Ability (both yours and your opponent’s).
items.zh: 在双方所有拥有特性的宝可梦上各放置 6 个伤害指示物。

items.en: You must discard a Chill Teaser Toy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
items.zh: 为了使用此特性，你必须从手牌中弃置 1 张「冰凉逗猫玩具」卡。在你的回合中，你可以使用 1 次，将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

items.en: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 从弃牌堆中把 1 张训练家卡加入手牌。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，就防止双方招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

items.en: Put damage counters on each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon until its remaining HP is 100.
items.zh: 在对手的每只后备宝可梦上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余 HP 为 100。

items.en: Both Active Pokémon are Knocked Out.
items.zh: 双方的战斗宝可梦都被击倒。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, Benched Stage 2 Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Abilities.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于后备，双方后备的 2 阶进化宝可梦都没有特性。

items.en: If 1 of your other Ancient Pokémon used an attack during your last turn, this attack does 150 more damage.
items.zh: 若自己的其他 1 只古代宝可梦在你的上个回合中使用过招式，则此招式造成 +150 伤害。

items.en: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.
items.zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 1 张卡。

items.en: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent’s deck.
items.zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 2 张卡。

items.en: Discard the top 3 cards of your opponent’s deck.
items.zh: 弃置对手牌库上方的 3 张卡。

items.en: This attack also does 130 damage to 2 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 此招式还对对手的 2 只后备宝可梦造成 130 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点与抗性。）

items.en: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent’s next turn, that Pokémon can’t retreat.
items.zh: 对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于中毒状态。在对手的下个回合中，那只宝可梦无法撤退。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 5 more damage counters on your opponent’s Poisoned Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，在宝可梦检查时，在对手的中毒宝可梦上多放置 5 个伤害指示物。

items.en: Look at the top 10 cards of your deck. You may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你的牌库上方的 10 张卡。你可以将其中任意数量的宝可梦放到你的后备。将其余的卡洗回你的牌库。

items.en: If your opponent has no Pokémon {ex} or Pokémon {V} in play, this Pokémon can’t attack.
items.zh: 若对手场上没有宝可梦 {ex} 或宝可梦 {V}，此宝可梦无法使用招式。

items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌中打出此宝可梦来进化你的 1 只宝可梦时，你可以回复你的战斗 {G} 宝可梦的所有伤害。若你以此方式回复了伤害，弃置该宝可梦身上的所有能量。

items.en: This attack does 60 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon {ex}. This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance.

items.en: Discard a random card from your opponent’s hand.

items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于灼伤状态。

items.zh: 若此宝可梦被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，则将其加入手牌而非弃牌堆。（弃置所有附着的卡牌。）

items.en: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself. Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
items.zh: 此宝可梦也对自己造成 70 点伤害。对手的战斗宝可梦现在处于麻痹和中毒状态。

items.en: Knock Out each of your opponent’s Pokémon that has 50 HP or less remaining.
items.zh: 将对手剩余 HP 为 50 或以下的每只宝可梦击倒。

items.en: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Dark Strike.
items.zh: 在你的下个回合中，此宝可梦无法使用「暗黑打击」。

items.en: If your opponent’s Active Pokémon is a Pokémon {ex}, this attack does 80 more damage.
items.zh: 若对手的战斗宝可梦是宝可梦 {ex}，此招式的伤害 +80。

items.en: Shuffle all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your deck, and this attack does 220 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
items.zh: 将此宝可梦身上附着的所有能量洗回你的牌库，此招式对对手的 1 只宝可梦造成 220 点伤害。（后备宝可梦不适用弱点和抗性。）

items.en: Reveal any number of Honedge, Doublade, and Aegislash from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.
items.zh: 从手牌中展示任意数量的独剑鞘、双剑鞘和坚盾剑怪，你以此方式每展示 1 张卡，此招式造成 60 点伤害。

items.en: This attack does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.
items.zh: 你的所有后备小拉达身上每放置 1 个伤害指示物，此招式造成 40 点伤害。

items.en: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can’t use more than 1 Ability that has “Last-Ditch” in its name each turn.
items.zh: 在你的回合中，当你从手牌将此宝可梦打到后备区时，你可以使用 1 次此特性。从牌库中检索 1 张支援者卡，展示并加入手牌。然后洗牌。每回合你只能使用 1 次名称中含有「绝境」的特性。

items.en: Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 反复抛硬币，直到出现反面。从牌库中检索最多等于正面数量的基本能量卡，附着于此宝可梦身上。然后洗牌。
此宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon with {F} Resistance, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只拥有 {F} 抗性的宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Discard random cards from your opponent’s hand until they have 5 cards in their hand.
items.zh: 随机弃置对手的手牌，直到对手的手牌为 5 张。

items.en: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Supporter cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 4 张卡。你可以展示其中任意数量的支援者卡并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
items.zh: 弃置你牌库上方的 2 张卡。

items.en: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can’t use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
items.zh: 选择场上的 1 只你的基础宝可梦。若你手牌中有从该宝可梦进化而来的 2 阶进化卡，则将那张卡放到该基础宝可梦身上使其进化，跳过 1 阶进化。你无法在你的首个回合使用此卡，也无法对在本回合被打出的基础宝可梦使用此卡。

items.en:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.
items.zh:
只有在对手的上个回合中有你的宝可梦被击倒时，你才可以使用此卡。

每位玩家将其手牌洗回其牌库。然后，你抽 5 张牌，对手抽 2 张牌。

items.en: Discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 从对手的 1 只宝可梦身上弃置 1 个特殊能量。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 3 Stage 1 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 只 1 阶进化宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Search your deck for a Pokémon with the same name as 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon in play, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只与对手场上 1 只宝可梦同名的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Item cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张物品卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。你的回合结束。

items.en: Draw a card for each of your Ancient Pokémon in play.
items.zh: 场上每有 1 只你的古代宝可梦，抽 1 张牌。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只 HP 为 70 或以下的基础宝可梦，放到你的后备区。然后洗牌。

items.en: Each player discards cards from their hand until they have 5 cards in their hand. Your opponent discards first. (If a player has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, they do not discard.)
items.zh: 每位玩家弃置手牌，直到其手牌为 5 张。对手先弃置。（若某位玩家的手牌为 5 张或更少，则其不弃置。）

items.en: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。若如此做，将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦交换。

items.en: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of your Future Pokémon.
items.zh: 从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于你的每只未来宝可梦身上。

items.en: Choose a Pokémon {ex} in your discard pile that has “Ogerpon” in its name, and switch it with 1 of your Pokémon {ex} in play that has “Ogerpon” in its name. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.
items.zh: 选择你弃牌堆中 1 只名称中含有「厄诡椪」的宝可梦 {ex}，并将其与场上 1 只名称中含有「厄诡椪」的你的宝可梦 {ex} 交换。附着的卡牌、伤害指示物、特殊状态、在场上的回合数以及任何其他效果都保留在新的宝可梦身上。

items.en: Reveal the top 5 cards of your opponent’s deck. You may choose any number of Basic Pokémon you find there and put those Pokémon onto their Bench. Your opponent shuffles the other cards back into their deck.
items.zh: 展示对手牌库上方的 5 张卡。你可以选择其中任意数量的基础宝可梦，并将那些宝可梦放到对手的后备区。对手将其他卡牌洗回其牌库。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you discard 3 other cards from your hand.

Search your deck for an Item card, a Pokémon Tool card, a Supporter card, and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
只有从手牌中弃置 3 张其他卡牌，你才可以使用此卡。

从牌库中检索 1 张物品卡、1 张宝可梦道具卡、1 张支援者卡和 1 张竞技场卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Put 1 of your Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
items.zh: 将你的 1 只宝可梦和其附着的所有卡牌加入手牌。

items.en: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 in any combination of {G} Pokémon and Basic {G} Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张卡。你可以展示其中最多 2 张 {G} 宝可梦卡和基本 {G} 能量卡（任意组合）并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en:
Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

This card can’t be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.
items.zh:
回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 150 点伤害。

此卡无法从弃牌堆加入手牌或放入牌库。

items.en: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 将你的弃牌堆中的 1 只宝可梦或 1 张基本能量卡加入手牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you have any Tera Pokémon in play.

Choose up to 2 of your Benched {C} Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them.
items.zh:
只有场上有你的太晶宝可梦时，你才可以使用此卡。

选择最多 2 只你的后备 {C} 宝可梦，从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于它们各自身上。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent’s Basic Pokémon cost {C} more.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于战斗区，对手的基础宝可梦使用的招式费用就增加 {C}。

items.en:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can’t be affected by any Special Conditions and can’t retreat.

At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
items.zh:
将此卡当作 60 HP 的基础 {C} 宝可梦来打出。此卡不会受到任何特殊状态的影响，也无法撤退。

在你的回合中的任意时间，你可以将此卡从场上弃置。

items.en: Search your deck for any number of Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索任意数量的不同类型的基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you go second, and only during your first turn.

Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
只有你后攻，且仅在你的首个回合，你才可以使用此卡。

从牌库中检索 1 张支援者卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库下方的 7 张卡。你可以展示其中 1 只宝可梦并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Your opponent counts the cards in their hand, shuffles those cards, and puts them on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw that many cards.
items.zh: 对手数出其手牌的张数，将这些卡牌洗牌并放到其牌库下方。若如此做，对手抽该数量的卡牌。

items.en: Discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from all of your opponent’s Pokémon, and discard a Stadium in play.
items.zh: 从对手的所有宝可梦身上弃置所有宝可梦道具和特殊能量，并弃置场上的 1 张竞技场卡。

items.en: Heal 60 damage from your Active {N} Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的战斗 {N} 宝可梦的 60 点伤害。

items.en: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order, or shuffle them and put them on the bottom of your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 3 张卡，以任意顺序放回，或将其洗牌并放到你的牌库下方。

items.en: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench to the new Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦交换。若如此做，你可以将任意数量的能量从你移到后备的那只宝可梦身上移到新的战斗宝可梦身上。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you go second, and only during your first turn.
Put an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon into their hand.
items.zh:
只有你后攻，且仅在你的首个回合，你才可以使用此卡。
将对手的 1 只宝可梦身上附着的 1 个能量放入对手的手牌。

items.en: Put up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 2 张支援者卡加入手牌。

items.en: Put up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 5 张宝可梦卡和基本能量卡（任意组合）加入手牌。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 5 Pokémon Tool cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 5 张宝可梦道具卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard an Energy from that Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的 1 只宝可梦的 60 点伤害。若你以此方式回复了伤害，则从该宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。
N 的 PP 提升剂

items.en: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本能量卡附着于你的 1 只后备的 N 的宝可梦身上。

items.en: Count your Prize cards, shuffle them, and put them on the bottom of your deck. Then, take that many cards from the top of your deck and put them face down as your Prize cards.
items.zh: 数出你的奖赏卡张数，将它们洗牌并放到你的牌库下方。然后从你的牌库上方取该数量的卡牌，背面朝下作为你的奖赏卡。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Hop’s Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础赫普的宝可梦，放到你的后备区。然后洗牌。

items.en: Move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
items.zh: 将 1 个基本能量从你的 1 只宝可梦移到你的另 1 只宝可梦身上。

items.en: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 2 张基本能量卡加入手牌。

items.en: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张基本能量卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，从对手的 1 只宝可梦身上弃置 1 个能量。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.

Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
只有从手牌中弃置 2 张其他卡牌，你才可以使用此卡。

从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张卡。你可以展示其中 1 张支援者卡并加入手牌。将其他卡牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦交换。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

items.en: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索任意数量的基础宝可梦，放到你的后备区。然后洗牌。

items.en: Search your deck for a Tera Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只太晶宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 5 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 5 张卡牌并将其弃置。然后洗牌。

items.en: Shuffle up to 5 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
items.zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 5 只宝可梦洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon. If that Pokémon is an Arven’s Pokémon, heal 100 damage from it instead.
items.zh: 回复你的战斗宝可梦的 30 点伤害。若该宝可梦是派帕的宝可梦，则改为回复其 100 点伤害。

items.en: Turn 1 of your opponent’s face-down Prize cards face up and choose a random card from your opponent’s hand. Your opponent reveals that card. You may have your opponent switch those cards. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.)
items.zh: 将对手的 1 张背面朝下的奖赏卡翻到正面，并从对手的手牌中随机选择 1 张卡。对手展示那张卡。你可以让对手交换这两张卡。（那张奖赏卡在游戏的剩余时间内保持正面朝上。）

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，从牌库中检索 1 只进化形态的火箭队的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。若为反面，从牌库中检索 1 只基础火箭队的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on your Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 抛硬币。若为正面，在对手的 1 只宝可梦身上放置 2 个伤害指示物。若为反面，在你的战斗宝可梦身上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

items.en: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 抛 2 次硬币。若 2 次都是正面，从牌库中检索 1 张基本能量卡，附着于你的 1 只宝可梦身上。然后洗牌。

items.en: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent’s) and discard them.
items.zh: 选择最多 2 张附着于宝可梦（你的或对手的）身上的宝可梦道具并将其弃置。

items.en: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 只要此宝可梦位于你的后备区，防止对手宝可梦的招式对此宝可梦造成的所有伤害。

items.en: Shuffle up to 5 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
items.zh: 将你的弃牌堆中最多 5 张基本能量卡洗回你的牌库。

items.en: During your opponent’s next turn, all of your {M} Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)
items.zh: 在对手的下个回合中，你所有的 {M} 宝可梦受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害减少 30 点（在计算弱点和抗性之后）。（这包括新上场的宝可梦。）

items.en: During this turn, attacks used by your {F} Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 在本回合中，你的 {F} 宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点和抗性之前）。

items.en: Search your deck for a Basic {F} Energy card or a Basic {F} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张基本 {F} 能量卡或 1 只基础 {F} 宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Devolve 1 of your evolved {P} Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can’t evolve this turn.)
items.zh: 将你的 1 只已进化的 {P} 宝可梦退化，将其身上任意数量的进化卡加入手牌。（该宝可梦在本回合无法进化。）

items.en: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex}, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只超级进化宝可梦 {ex}，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon.
items.zh: 从你的弃牌堆中把 1 张基本 {P} 能量卡附着于你的 1 只后备 {P} 宝可梦身上。

items.en: Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokémon that has 3 or more Energy attached.
items.zh: 回复附着了 3 个或更多能量的你的战斗宝可梦的 80 点伤害。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you discard a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand.

Discard a Pokémon Tool or Special Energy card from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon, or discard a Stadium in play.
items.zh:
只有从手牌中弃置 1 张基本 {R} 能量卡，你才可以使用此卡。

从对手的 1 只宝可梦身上弃置 1 张宝可梦道具或特殊能量卡，或弃置场上的 1 张竞技场卡。

items.en: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose an Energy card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.
items.zh: 对手展示其手牌，你选择其中 1 张能量卡并将其放到其牌库下方。

items.en: Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.
items.zh: 每当你的对手从手牌打出支援者卡时，防止该卡对此宝可梦造成的所有效果。

items.en: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn’t have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只没有规则栏的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。（宝可梦 {ex}、宝可梦 {V} 等拥有规则栏。）

items.en: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的战斗宝可梦的 20 点伤害，并解除其 1 个特殊状态。

items.en: If the Team Rocket’s Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Team Rocket’s Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的火箭队的宝可梦位于战斗区，并受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使该火箭队的宝可梦被击倒），则进行攻击的宝可梦现在处于睡眠状态。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. Then, discard this card.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦 HP 全满，且将被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，则它不会被击倒，其剩余 HP 变为 10。然后，弃置此卡。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 2 cards.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），抽 2 张牌。

items.en: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C} less. If that Pokémon’s remaining HP is 30 or less, it has no Retreat Cost.
items.zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦的撤退费用减少 {C}。若该宝可梦的剩余 HP 为 30 或更少，则它没有撤退费用。

items.en: Attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +50（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +100 HP.
items.zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦的 HP +100。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has a Retreat Cost of exactly 4, is in the Active Spot, and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, move up to 3 Basic Energy cards from that Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦的撤退费用正好为 4、位于战斗区，且被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，则以任意方式从该宝可梦上将最多 3 张基本能量卡移动到你的后备宝可梦上。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), move an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），从进行攻击的宝可梦上移动 1 个能量到对手的 1 只后备宝可梦上。

items.en: Attacks used by the Poisoned Pokémon this card is attached to do 40 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 此卡所附着的处于中毒状态的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +40（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en: At the end of your turn (after your attack), if the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to it.
items.zh: 在你的回合结束时（你的招式使用之后），若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，你可以从弃牌堆中将 1 张基本能量卡附着于它。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s {P} Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦受到对手 {P} 宝可梦的招式伤害，则它受到的伤害 -60（在计算弱点与抗性之后），并弃置此卡。

items.en: When the Tera Pokémon this card is attached to uses an attack, that attack costs 1 Energy less. (The Energy can be of any type.)
items.zh: 此卡所附着的太晶宝可梦使用招式时，该招式的能量费用减少 1 个。（该能量可为任意属性。）

items.en: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, the Retreat Cost of both Active Pokémon is {C} more.
items.zh: 只要此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，双方战斗宝可梦的撤退费用增加 {C}。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this card.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），在进行攻击的宝可梦上放置 12 个伤害指示物。若你以此方式放置了伤害指示物，弃置此卡。

items.en: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost {C} less.
items.zh: 若你的剩余奖赏卡多于对手，则此卡所附着的宝可梦使用的招式的能量费用减少 {C}。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，从牌库中检索最多 3 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s {N} Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦受到对手 {N} 宝可梦的招式伤害，则它受到的伤害 -60（在计算弱点与抗性之后），并弃置此卡。

items.en: Attacks used by the Hop’s Pokémon this card is attached to cost {C} less and do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 此卡所附着的赫普的宝可梦使用的招式的能量费用减少 {C}，且对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en: If the Lillie’s Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的莉莉艾的宝可梦被对手宝可梦的招式伤害击倒，该玩家拿取的奖赏卡减少 1 张。

items.en: The Cynthia’s Pokémon this card is attached to gets +70 HP.
items.zh: 此卡所附着的竹兰的宝可梦的 HP +70。

items.en: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C}{C} less.
items.zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦的撤退费用减少 {C}{C}。

items.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn’t have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的宝可梦没有规则栏，则它使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。（宝可梦{ex}、宝可梦{V}等拥有规则栏。）

items.en: If the {D} Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
items.zh: 若此卡所附着的 {D} 宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），在进行攻击的宝可梦上放置 4 个伤害指示物。

items.en: The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon that have an Ability (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 此卡所附着的宝可梦受到拥有特性的对手宝可梦的招式伤害 -30（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

items.en: Attacks used by the Pikachu {ex} this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 此卡所附着的皮卡丘{ex}使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +50（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en: The {N} Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s {G}, {R}, {W}, or {L} Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 此卡所附着的 {N} 宝可梦受到对手的 {G}、{R}、{W} 或 {L} 宝可梦的招式伤害 -50（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

items.en: The Mega Zygarde {ex} this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
items.zh: 此卡所附着的超级基格尔德{ex}可以使用此卡上的招式。（你仍然需要支付使用该招式所需的能量。）

items.en: Draw 2 cards. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand, draw 2 more cards.
items.zh: 抽 2 张牌。然后，若你的手牌为 10 张或更多，再抽 2 张牌。

items.en: Reveal up to 2 Pokémon in your hand and put them into your deck. If you do, search your deck for up to that many Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 展示你手牌中最多 2 只宝可梦并将其放入你的牌库。若你如此做，从牌库中检索最多与其次数相同数量的宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Put up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
items.zh: 从弃牌堆中以任意组合将最多 3 张没有规则栏的宝可梦卡和基本能量卡加入手牌。（宝可梦{ex}、宝可梦{V}等拥有规则栏。）

items.en: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 6 张牌，将其中 2 张加入手牌。弃置其他的牌。

items.en: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard up to 2 Item cards you find there.
items.zh: 对手展示其手牌，你从其中弃置最多 2 张物品卡。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Draw a card for each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.
items.zh:
仅当你从手牌中弃置另 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

对手每有 1 只后备宝可梦，抽 1 张牌。

items.en: Search your deck for a card that has no Abilities and evolves from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can use this card on a Pokémon you put down when you were setting up to play or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张没有特性且进化自你的 1 只宝可梦的卡，并将其放到该宝可梦上使其进化。然后洗牌。你可以对准备阶段放下的宝可梦或本回合放入场中的宝可梦使用此卡。

items.en: Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has 30 HP or less remaining.
items.zh: 回复你的 1 只剩余 HP 为 30 或更少的宝可梦的所有伤害。

items.en:
Choose 1:

• Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
• During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} and Active Pokémon {V} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh:
选择 1 项：

• 将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。
• 本回合中，你的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}和战斗宝可梦{V}造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
items.zh:
若你先攻，你可以在你的第一个回合中使用此卡。

弃置你的手牌并抽 5 张牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put up to 3 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh:
仅当你的任意宝可梦在对手的上个回合中被击倒时，才能使用此卡。

查看你牌库上方的 8 张牌，将其中最多 3 张加入手牌。将其他牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Search your deck for a Stadium card and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张竞技场卡和 1 张能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Choose up to 2 of your {D} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon in this way, it is now Poisoned.
items.zh: 选择你的最多 2 只 {D} 宝可梦。对每只该宝可梦，从牌库中检索 1 张基本 {D} 能量卡并附着于该宝可梦。然后洗牌。若你以此方式将能量附着于你的战斗宝可梦，则它现在处于中毒状态。

items.en:
You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.

Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
仅当此卡是你手牌中的最后 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

从牌库中检索最多 2 张卡并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Your opponent discards cards from their hand until they have 3 cards in their hand.
items.zh: 对手从其手牌中弃置卡，直到其手牌为 3 张。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put 1 of them into your hand. Attach the other to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 张属性不同的基本能量卡，展示它们，将其中 1 张加入手牌。将另 1 张附着于你的 1 只宝可梦。然后洗牌。

items.en: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.
items.zh: 将你的手牌洗回你的牌库。然后，抽 4 张牌。若对手的剩余奖赏卡为 3 张或更少，则改为抽 8 张牌。

items.en: Put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you put 2 cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw 4 cards. (If you can’t put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck, you can’t use this card.)
items.zh: 以任意顺序将你手牌中的 2 张卡放到你的牌库底部。若你以此方式将 2 张卡放到了牌库底部，抽 4 张牌。（若你无法将手牌中的 2 张卡放到牌库底部，则不能使用此卡。）

items.en:
You can use this card only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining.

During this turn, if your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your Tera Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card.
items.zh:
仅当对手的剩余奖赏卡正好为 2 张时，才能使用此卡。

本回合中，若对手的战斗宝可梦被你的太晶宝可梦使用的招式伤害击倒，则多拿取 1 张奖赏卡。

items.en: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon and a Trainer card you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张牌。你可以展示其中找到的 1 张宝可梦卡和 1 张训练家卡并加入手牌。将其他牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
items.zh: 将你的战斗宝可梦与你的 1 只后备宝可梦互换。若你如此做，抽牌直到你的手牌为 5 张。

items.en: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.
items.zh: 将对手的 1 只后备基础宝可梦换入战斗区。若你如此做，新的战斗宝可梦现在处于混乱状态。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon {ex}, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 只宝可梦{ex}，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 弃置你的手牌，从牌库中检索 1 只宝可梦、1 张支援者卡和 1 张基本能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Draw 4 cards. At the end of this turn, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, discard your hand.
items.zh: 抽 4 张牌。在本回合结束时，若你的手牌为 5 张或更多，弃置你的手牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
items.zh:
仅当你从手牌中弃置另 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

抽牌直到你的手牌为 6 张。

items.en: Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
items.zh: 从对手的 1 只宝可梦上弃置 1 张宝可梦道具和 1 个特殊能量。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or 1 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 2 只基础宝可梦或 1 只进化宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 本回合中，你的宝可梦使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦{ex}造成的伤害 +40（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en: Heal 70 damage from your Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的战斗宝可梦的 70 点伤害。

items.en: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
items.zh: 每位玩家将手牌洗回牌库并抽 4 张牌。

items.en: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards.
items.zh: 抽 2 张牌。若对手的剩余奖赏卡为 3 张或更少，再抽 2 张牌。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan’s Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 3 张以任意组合的阿响的宝可梦卡和基本 {R} 能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket’s Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead.
items.zh: 抽牌直到你的手牌为 5 张。若你场上的所有宝可梦都是火箭队的宝可梦，则改为抽牌直到你的手牌为 8 张。

items.en:
You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket’s Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards.
items.zh:
仅当你的任意火箭队的宝可梦在对手的上个回合中被击倒时，才能使用此卡。

每位玩家将手牌洗回牌库。然后，你抽 5 张牌，对手抽 3 张牌。

items.en: Switch your Active Team Rocket’s Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket’s Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
items.zh: 将你的战斗火箭队的宝可梦与你的 1 只后备火箭队的宝可梦互换。若你如此做，将对手的 1 只后备宝可梦换入战斗区。

items.en: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 张训练家卡，展示它并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
若你先攻，你可以在你的第一个回合中使用此卡。

从牌库中检索最多 3 只基础火箭队的宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
items.zh: 从你的后备宝可梦移动最多 2 个能量到你的战斗宝可梦上。

items.en: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的每只宝可梦的 40 点伤害。

items.en: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards.
items.zh: 每位玩家将手牌洗回牌库。然后，抛硬币。若为正面，你抽 5 张牌，对手抽 3 张牌。若为反面，你抽 3 张牌，对手抽 5 张牌。

items.en: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只进化宝可梦和 1 张能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards.
items.zh: 询问对手是否双方各拿取 1 张奖赏卡。若是，双方各拿取 1 张奖赏卡。若否，你抽 4 张牌。

items.en: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.
items.zh: 将你的手牌洗回你的牌库。然后，抽 6 张牌。若你的剩余奖赏卡正好为 6 张，则改为抽 8 张牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent’s Pokémon {ex}.
items.zh:
仅当对手的剩余奖赏卡为 2 张或更少时，才能使用此卡。

选择你场上的 1 只宝可梦。在对手的下个回合中，防止对手的宝可梦{ex}的招式对该宝可梦造成的所有伤害和效果。

items.en: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex}. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand.
items.zh: 回复你的 1 只超级进化宝可梦{ex}的所有伤害。若你以此方式回复了伤害，将该宝可梦上附着的所有能量加入你的手牌。

items.en: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put a {D} Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck. You can’t use this card during your first turn.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 7 张牌，将其中找到的 1 只 {D} 宝可梦放到你的后备区。将其他牌洗牌并放到你的牌库底部。你不能在你的第一个回合中使用此卡。

items.en: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦、1 只 1 阶进化宝可梦和 1 只 2 阶进化宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en: Search your deck for up to 7 Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh: 从牌库中检索最多 7 张基本 {R} 能量卡，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Search your deck for up to 4 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
items.zh:
仅当你从手牌中弃置另 1 张卡时，才能使用此卡。

从牌库中检索最多 4 只 {L} 宝可梦，展示它们并加入手牌。然后洗牌。

items.en:
You can use this card only if you have N’s Darmanitan, N’s Zoroark {ex}, N’s Vanilluxe, N’s Klinklang, N’s Reshiram, and N’s Zekrom in play.

During this turn, if your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your N’s Pokémon, take 3 more Prize cards.
items.zh:
仅当你场上有 N 的达摩狒狒、N 的索罗亚克{ex}、N 的双倍多多冰、N 的齿轮怪、N 的莱希拉姆和 N 的捷克罗姆时，才能使用此卡。

本回合中，若对手的战斗宝可梦被你的 N 的宝可梦使用的招式伤害击倒，则多拿取 3 张奖赏卡。

items.en: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
items.zh: 查看你牌库上方的 6 张牌，将其中找到的 1 张基本能量卡附着于你的 1 只宝可梦。将其他牌洗回你的牌库。

items.en: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player flips a coin. If heads, that player draws 6 cards. If tails, they draw 3 cards.
items.zh: 每位玩家将其手牌洗牌并放到其牌库底部。若任一玩家以此方式将卡放到了牌库底部，则每位玩家抛硬币。若为正面，该玩家抽 6 张牌。若为反面，其抽 3 张牌。

items.en: Put up to 4 in any combination of {F} Pokémon and Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
items.zh: 从弃牌堆中以任意组合将最多 4 张 {F} 宝可梦卡和基本 {F} 能量卡加入手牌。

items.en: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. Before drawing cards, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. (If you can’t draw any cards in this way, you can’t use this card.)
items.zh: 抽牌直到你的手牌为 5 张。在抽牌之前，你可以从手牌中弃置任意数量的卡。（若你无法以此方式抽牌，则不能使用此卡。）

items.en:
You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.
items.zh:
仅当你的剩余奖赏卡多于对手时，才能使用此卡。

从你的弃牌堆中将最多 2 张基本能量卡附着于你的 1 只 2 阶进化宝可梦。

items.en: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokémon.
items.zh: 回复你的 1 只 {P} 宝可梦的 150 点伤害。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, if they played a Supporter card from their hand this turn, they may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，若该玩家本回合从手牌中使用了支援者卡，则可以使用 1 次，回复其每只宝可梦的 10 点伤害。

items.en: During Pokémon Checkup, put 2 more damage counters on each Poisoned non-{D} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s).
items.zh: 在宝可梦检查时，在每只中毒的非 {D} 宝可梦（双方的）上多放置 2 个伤害指示物。

items.en: {M} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: {M} 宝可梦（双方的）受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害 -30（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

items.en: Each Pokémon that has any Energy attached (both yours and your opponent’s) recovers from all Special Conditions and can’t be affected by any Special Conditions.
items.zh: 所有附着有能量的宝可梦（双方的）从所有特殊状态中恢复，且不会受到任何特殊状态的影响。

items.en: Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) have no effect.
items.zh: 附着于每只宝可梦（双方的）的宝可梦道具没有效果。

items.en:
Prevent all damage done to Pokémon that don’t have a Rule Box (both yours and your opponent’s) by attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon {ex} and Pokémon {V}. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

This card can’t be put into your hand or deck from the discard pile.
items.zh:
防止对手的宝可梦{ex}和宝可梦{V}的招式对没有规则栏的宝可梦（双方的）造成的所有伤害。（宝可梦{ex}、宝可梦{V}等拥有规则栏。）

此卡不能从弃牌堆被放入你的手牌或牌库。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may put a card from their hand on top of their deck.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，将手牌中的 1 张卡放到其牌库上方。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may search their deck for a Stage 1 Pokémon that evolves from 1 of their Basic Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. If that Pokémon was evolved in this way, that player may search their deck for a Stage 2 Pokémon that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, that player shuffles their deck. (Players can’t evolve a Basic Pokémon during their first turn or a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.)
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只进化自其 1 只基础宝可梦的 1 阶进化宝可梦，并将其放到该宝可梦上使其进化。若该宝可梦以此方式进化，该玩家可以从牌库中检索 1 只进化自该宝可梦的 2 阶进化宝可梦，并将其放到该宝可梦上使其进化。然后，该玩家洗牌。（玩家不能在其第一个回合中进化基础宝可梦，也不能进化本回合放入场中的基础宝可梦。）

items.en:
Each player who has any Tera Pokémon in play can have up to 8 Pokémon on their Bench.

If a player no longer has any Tera Pokémon in play, that player discards Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5. When this card leaves play, both players discard Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5, and the player who played this card discards first.
items.zh:
场上有太晶宝可梦的每位玩家，其后备区最多可有 8 只宝可梦。

若某位玩家场上不再有太晶宝可梦，该玩家从其后备区弃置宝可梦直到其剩余 5 只。当此卡离场时，双方玩家都从其后备区弃置宝可梦直到其剩余 5 只，且放置此卡的玩家先弃置。

items.en: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) gets +30 HP.
items.zh: 场上的每只基础宝可梦（双方的）HP +30。

items.en: Each Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) gets -30 HP.
items.zh: 场上的每只 2 阶进化宝可梦（双方的）HP -30。

items.en: N’s Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Retreat Cost.
items.zh: 场上的 N 的宝可梦（双方的）没有撤退费用。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may put up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards from their discard pile into their hand.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从弃牌堆中将最多 2 张基本 {L} 能量卡加入手牌。

items.en: Attacks used by Hop’s Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) do 30 more damage to the opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 赫普的宝可梦（双方的）使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害 +30（在计算弱点与抗性之前）。

items.en: {C} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) have no Abilities.
items.zh: 场上的 {C} 宝可梦（双方的）没有特性。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，若该玩家本回合从手牌中使用了名称中含有「火箭队」的支援者卡，则可以使用 1 次，抽 2 张牌。

items.en: Steven’s Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
items.zh: 大吾的宝可梦（双方的）受到对手宝可梦的招式伤害 -30（在计算弱点与抗性之后）。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may search their deck for a Marnie’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只玛俐的宝可梦，展示它并加入手牌。然后，该玩家洗牌。

items.en: Whenever any player puts a Basic non-{D} Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
items.zh: 每当任一玩家在其回合中将基础的非 {D} 宝可梦放到其后备区时，在该宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

items.en: Each player’s {G} Pokémon can evolve into {G} Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn.
items.zh: 每位玩家的 {G} 宝可梦可以在其使用这些宝可梦的回合中进化为 {G} 宝可梦，但其第一个回合除外。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may switch their Active {W} Pokémon with 1 of their Benched {W} Pokémon.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，将其战斗 {W} 宝可梦与自己的 1 只后备 {W} 宝可梦互换。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have {P} Pokémon in play.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从手牌中弃置 1 张能量卡，以抽牌直到其手牌张数等于其场上 {P} 宝可梦的数量。

items.en: Prevent all damage counters from being placed on Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) by effects of attacks and Abilities from the opponent’s Pokémon. (Damage from attacks is still taken.)
items.zh: 防止对手宝可梦的招式和特性的效果在后备宝可梦（双方的）上放置伤害指示物。（招式的伤害仍会承受。）

items.en: Confused Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) don’t recover from that Special Condition when they evolve or devolve.
items.zh: 处于混乱状态的宝可梦（双方的）在进化或退化时不会从该特殊状态中恢复。

items.en: Attacks used by each Tera Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) cost {C} more.
items.zh: 场上的每只太晶宝可梦（双方的）使用的招式的能量费用增加 {C}。

items.en: Once during each player’s turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends.
items.zh: 每位玩家的回合中，该玩家可以使用 1 次，从牌库中检索 1 只基础宝可梦并将其放到其后备区。然后，该玩家洗牌。若某位玩家以此方式检索了牌库，其回合结束。
